desc: Implement the static value-start gap counting solution in Python: build pos[0..N+1], for each x with nonempty pos[x] count subarrays containing x and no x-1 by iterating gaps between pos[x-1] (sentinels 0 and N+1) and subtracting no-x subarrays with a monotonic pointer over pos[x], accumulate the answer, and verify outputs 16, 23, 129 on the samples.
Check edge cases and complexity: N=1, all values equal, strictly increasing values, alternating 1/2, and confirm total work is O(N) with Python int arithmetic.
